newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Centocor upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Centocor upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said on Wednesday it upgraded its rating for Centocor Inc to buy from attractive based on the current stock price.

-- Vector said it believes Centocor's ReoPro product, used to stabilize certain patients with unstable angina, who are also unresponsive to conventional therapy, will continue to show strong growth this year.
-- The one-year price target is $47, Vector said.
-- Centocor is a drug development company.
-- Its shares closed down 1-5/8 on Wednesday at 29/
